source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT COUNT(1) CNT FROM D360.STG_BOB_TBLMARKETSEGMENT WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
STG.[ID]
,STG.[CD]
,STG.[CREATED_BY]
,convert(date,[CREATED_DT]) as CREATED_DT
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[DEL],' ',''),''),0)) as DEL
,[DSCP]
,[UPDATED_BY]
,convert(date,[UPDATED_DT]) as UPDATED_DT
,convert(numeric(15,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[VERSION],' ',''),''),0)) as VERSION
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[BOB_TBLMARKETSEGMENT_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_BOB_TBLMARKETSEGMENT] STG ON STG.[ID] = DELTA.[ID] 
 WHERE H = 'D'
